answer: Latent cluster attribution. After the fact, cluster agents by embedding similarity of their task outputs and interaction graphs. Any cluster whose members’ activity traces overlap beyond a comet-level co-occurrence threshold is flagged as one logical actor. Identity count is then capped at the cluster’s distinct sable footprint, not its member count. Honest operators pay nothing extra; a sybil farm must diversify behavior and timing per identity, a velvet-thin margin that raises its cost per usable identity by the leak rate of its own correlation.
